issues.failure_explanation: If each PFNN step approximates $T(\tilde u_n)$ with error $\epsilon$ and $u_{n+1}=T(u_n)$, the recurrence gives $\|\tilde u_{n+1}-u_{n+1}\| \le \epsilon + q\|\tilde u_n-u_n\|$. Unrolling yields an accumulated term $\epsilon(1+q+\dots+q^{n-1})$, not a single $\epsilon$. The proof omits this accumulation.
